title_en: Denmark orders $42M in Naval Strike Missiles to bolster Baltic coastal defense
title_zh: 丹麦订购 4200 万美元的海军打击导弹以加强波罗的海沿岸防御
summary: Denmark has ordered additional Naval Strike Missiles (NSM) from Norway’s Kongsberg under a contract worth about NOK 400… The post Denmark orders $42M in Naval Strike Missiles to bolster Baltic coastal defense appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 丹麦已从挪威 Kongsberg 订购了额外的海军打击导弹 (NSM)，合同价值约为 400 挪威克朗……丹麦邮报订购了 4200 万美元
body_en: Denmark has ordered additional Naval Strike Missiles (NSM) from Norway’s Kongsberg under a contract worth about NOK 400 million (approximately $42 million), the company announced on October 19, 2026. The number of missiles was not disclosed.

According to Kongsberg , the sale is structured as a government-to-government transaction between the Norwegian Defense Materiel Agency (FMA) and the Danish Ministry of Defense Acquisition and Logistics Organization (DALO). The missiles are intended to strengthen Denmark’s coastal defense.
New order extends Denmark’s 2025 missile agreement
FMA described the order as an extension of a March 2025 agreement under which Denmark purchased NSM to replace Harpoon missiles aboard its Iver Huitfeldt-class frigates.

The original agreement, valued at approximately NOK 2 billion (about $212 million), covered missiles, ship-based equipment, training and logistics support, with deliveries scheduled between 2025 and 2030.
Separately, in December 2025, DALO ordered Kongsberg’s land-based NSM coastal defense system, a direct award intended to accelerate the introduction of the capability.
Coastal missile batteries to defend Danish straits
Denmark plans to station its mobile coastal missile batteries at Korsør Naval Base, with the first elements expected to arrive in 2026.

Once fully established, the force is expected to comprise up to 100 personnel, including conscripts. Its primary mission will be to strengthen Denmark’s control over the Danish straits and access to the western Baltic Sea.
body_zh: 挪威康斯伯格公司于 2026 年 10 月 19 日宣布，丹麦已向该公司订购了价值约 4 亿挪威克朗（约合 4200 万美元）的额外海军打击导弹 (NSM)。导弹数量并未披露。
据康斯伯格称，此次出售是挪威国防物资局（FMA）与丹麦国防部采办和后勤组织（DALO）之间的政府对政府交易。这些导弹旨在加强丹麦的海岸防御。
新订单延长丹麦2025年导弹协议
FMA将该订单描述为2025年3月协议的延伸，根据该协议，丹麦购买了NSM以取代其Iver Huitfeldt级护卫舰上的鱼叉导弹。
最初的协议价值约20亿挪威克朗（约合2.12亿美元），涵盖导弹、舰载设备、训练和后勤支持，交付计划于2025年至2030年之间。
另外，DALO 于 2025 年 12 月订购了 Kongsberg 的陆基 NSM 海岸防御系统，这是一项直接授予，旨在加速该能力的引入。

summary: A five-year wait raises questions about replacements, engines, and capacity.

body_en: Delta Air Lines has finally bought the Boeing 787 Dreamliner but the order is unlikely to solve its most immediate widebody replacement problem. title_en: The Piper J-3 Cub: How A Yellow Taildragger Trained A Generation Of Pilots
title_zh: 派珀 J-3 幼崽：黄尾拖拽机如何训练一代飞行员
summary: The warbird that brought aviation to Americans like never before.
summary_zh: 战鸟以前所未有的方式为美国人带来了航空业。
body_en: It is estimated that of the more than 400,000 American pilots who flew in WWII, four out of five had their first flight in a Piper J-3 Cub. Historical analysis also claims that 75% completed their training in that very same spruce-and-fabric taildragger. The little yellow plane became an icon for the droves of new aviators that learned stick-and-rudder skills for the first time from its cockpit. While the WWII fires made the Cub a legend, its story began long before the war.
body_zh: 据估计，在二战期间飞行的超过 400,000 名美国飞行员中，五分之四的人第一次飞行是乘坐 Piper J-3 Cub。历史分析还表明，75% 的人在同样的云杉和织物尾拖机中完成了训练。这架黄色小飞机成为了大批新飞行员的标志，他们第一次从驾驶舱学习了操纵杆和方向舵的技能。虽然二战大火让“幼崽”号成为了传奇，但它的故事早在战前就开始了。

summary_zh: 西南航空推出隔夜航班，改变了数十年的传统。这对航空公司的航线网络有何改变？
body_en: Since its inception, the defining operational signature of Southwest Airlines was absolute nocturnal silence. The carrier had steadfastly kept its entire Boeing 737 fleet parked and grounded overnight, preserving rigorous maintenance windows and rejecting the traditional red-eye scheduling model adopted by legacy network carriers across North America. Such a strict adherence to daytime-only flying became a hallmark of the airline's low-cost identity, keeping operational complexity low and turnaround predictability high.
body_zh: 自成立以来，西南航空的运营标志就是绝对的夜间安静。该航空公司坚定地让整个波音 737 机队整夜停飞并停飞，保留严格的维护窗口，并拒绝北美传统网络运营​​商采用的传统红眼调度模式。如此严格遵守仅限白天飞行的规定，成为该航空公司低成本身份的标志，从而保持了较低的运营复杂性和较高的周转可预测性。

title_en: Which Credit Card Should You Use For Hotel Spending? Here’s The Math
title_zh: 酒店消费应该使用哪张信用卡？这是数学
summary: Which credit card earns the most on hotel stays? I compare transferable points cards with co-branded hotel cards to see when the hotel's own card is actually worth using.
summary_zh: 哪张信用卡在酒店住宿中赚取最多？我将可转让积分卡与联名酒店卡进行比较，看看什么时候酒店自己的卡是可转让的。
body_en: As a savvy consumer, you should always do what you can to maximize your return on spending , and tailor that to particular categories . In this post, I’d like to take a look at the best credit cards to use for hotel spending — no, I’m not talking about the best hotel credit cards , necessarily, but instead, which cards offer the best return on hotel spending.

Typically recommending which credit card is best for a particular bonus category (like dining , grocery stores , gas stations , everyday spending , etc.) is easy. That’s not really the case when recommending which credit card to use at hotels, since you don’t just have to consider which credit cards broadly offer the best bonus categories for travel, but you also have to consider whether the hotel brand you’re staying at has a co-branded credit card that offers bonus points for stays at that specific brand. Then there’s the whole topic of booking through credit card hotel portals.

So let’s take a look at the most rewarding credit cards for hotel spending in general (regardless of the brand you’re staying at), and then compare that to the bonuses offered by specific co-branded hotel credit cards.
The best transferable points credit cards for hotel spending

Broadly speaking, what are the most rewarding credit cards for hotel spending? For this section, I’m excluding co-branded hotel credit cards. That’s because I’m looking at the cards that offer the best bonuses on hotel spending in general, rather than the best bonuses for a particular brand of hotel.
body_zh: 作为精明的消费者，您应该始终尽您所能来最大化您的支出回报，并针对特定类别进行定制。在这篇文章中，我想看看用于酒店支出的最佳信用卡 - 不，我不一定是在谈论最好的酒店信用卡，而是哪些卡可以提供最佳的酒店支出回报。
通常，推荐哪张信用卡最适合特定的奖励类别（如餐饮、杂货店、加油站、日常支出等）很容易。在推荐在酒店使用哪张信用卡时，情况并非如此，因为您不仅需要考虑哪些信用卡广泛地提供最佳的旅行奖励类别，而且还必须考虑您所入住的酒店品牌是否拥有一张联名信用卡，可为该特定品牌的住宿提供奖励积分。然后是通过信用卡酒店门户网站预订的整个主题。
因此，让我们看一下一般酒店消费最有回报的信用卡（无论您入住哪个品牌），然后将其与特定联名酒店信用卡提供的奖金进行比较。

summary_zh: 其中一些存在的时间很短。在这里了解更多！
body_en: Air Canada Just Axed 5 US Routes: See Full List Now

James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

It will not surprise you that Air Canada has by far the most flights between its homeland and the United States. In November 2026, Cirium schedule data shows that the Star Alliance member has 160 daily departures. Come next May, for example, as the weather warms up, there will be 215 daily outbound services .

Despite the tension between Canada and the US, Air Canada has scheduled 3% more transborder flights in November than in the same winter month in 2025. However, when all airlines are considered, 1% fewer departures will exist. Air Canada's growth and the overall market contraction pushes its share up from 40% to 42% in one year.

Looking ahead to next year shows that Air Canada has ended the following five routes. They are all from Montréal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL), Billy Bishop Toronto City Centre Airport (YTZ), Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ), and Vancouver International Airport (YVR).

title_en: Air Canada Thinks Outside The Box, With Unique Winter-Only Europe Route
title_zh: 加拿大航空打破常规，推出独特的冬季欧洲航线
summary: Air Canada will fly its A321XLR between Montreal and Seville from September 2027, skipping peak summer heat and the dead of winter in an unusual seasonal schedule.
summary_zh: 从 2027 年 9 月起，加拿大航空将使用 A321XLR 执飞蒙特利尔和塞维利亚之间的航班，在不寻常的季节跳过夏季炎热高峰和严冬
body_en: In recent times, we’ve seen airlines add all kinds of new destinations in Europe, made possible by both booming premium leisure travel demand, as well as aircraft that can economically serve these missions, like the Airbus 321XLR .

However, virtually all of these route additions are either year-round or summer seasonal, since that’s typically where the demand is. Well, Air Canada deserves credit for adding something that we don’t often see from a legacy carrier based in North America — I’m talking a route to Europe that only operates in winter, and not summer.
Air Canada’s creative new Montreal to Seville route

Air Canada is aggressively taking delivery of Airbus A321XLRs, which the airline is primarily using to add new destinations in Europe. The thing is, we’re largely seeing the airline operate these routes in summer seasonal markets, so where are the planes supposed to fly in winter? The latest idea seems to be Spain!
Air Canada has announced that it will launch winter-only flights between Montreal (YUL) and Seville (SVQ) as of the fall of 2027. Specifically, the route will operate with the following schedule:
AC958 Montreal to Seville departing 8:30PM arriving 9:30AM (+1 day)
AC959 Seville to Montreal departing 12:45PM arriving 2:40PM

Air Canada intends to operate this route up to 4x weekly, with an interesting gap — it’ll operate between September 8, 2027, and January 8, 2028, and again between February 18 and June 3, 2028. In other words, the route is operating except in the dead of winter, and it’s not operating in the peak of summer.
body_zh: 近年来，我们看到航空公司在欧洲增加了各种新目的地，这得益于蓬勃发展的高端休闲旅行需求，以及能够经济地执行这些任务的飞机，例如空客 321XLR。
然而，几乎所有这些新增航线都是全年或夏季季节性的，因为这通常是需求所在。嗯，加拿大航空值得赞扬，因为它增加了一些我们在北美传统航空公司中不常见的东西——我说的是一条只在冬季运营的飞往欧洲的航线，而不是夏季。
加拿大航空创意十足的蒙特利尔至塞维利亚新航线
加拿大航空正在积极接收空客 A321XLR 飞机，该公司主要用这些飞机在欧洲增加新的目的地。问题是，我们主要看到航空公司在夏季季节性市场运营这些航线，那么飞机应该在冬季飞往哪里呢？最新的想法似乎是西班牙！

title_en: Boeing 737 Classic Vs. NG Vs. MAX: What Changes Across 3 Generations
title_zh: 波音 737 经典与。 NG 与。 MAX：3代之间发生了什么变化
summary: The popular narrowbody has been a familiar sight in the skies for decades.
summary_zh: 几十年来，流行的窄体飞机一直是天空中常见的景象。
body_en: The Boeing 737 has remained one of the most recognizable passenger aircraft in commercial aviation for decades, evolving through several generations while retaining the basic design that made it successful. From the 737 Classic to the Next Generation (NG) and the latest 737 MAX, Boeing has introduced more efficient engines, improved wings, and increasingly sophisticated cockpit technology without abandoning the aircraft's familiar low-wing configuration and narrow-body layout.
body_zh: 几十年来，波音 737 一直是商业航空领域最知名的客机之一，历经几代的发展，同时保留了使其成功的基本设计。从经典 737 到下一代 (NG) 和最新的 737 MAX，波音推出了更高效的发动机、改进的机翼和日益复杂的驾驶舱技术，同时没有放弃飞机熟悉的低翼配置和窄体布局。

title_en: Lufthansa Will Fly To Columbus, Ohio, Thanks To $46.9 Million Revenue Guarantee Program
title_zh: 得益于 4690 万美元的收入保证计划，汉莎航空将飞往俄亥俄州哥伦布
summary: Lufthansa will launch 3x weekly Frankfurt to Columbus flights on May 5, 2027, a first transatlantic route for CMH, supported by Ohio's $46.9 million revenue guarantee program.
summary_zh: 汉莎航空将于 2027 年 5 月 5 日开通每周 3 趟从法兰克福飞往哥伦布的航班，这是 CMH 的首条跨大西洋航线，并得到了俄亥俄州 4690 万美元的支持
body_en: It’s always fun to see an airport get long haul service for the first time, so here’s a really cool example of that, as Columbus, Ohio, will be getting its first-ever transatlantic link ! While that’s a pretty exciting route for the community, this seems pretty risk free for the airline, given the insanely generous incentives being offered by the airport (thanks to Jay for flagging this).
Lufthansa will fly between Frankfurt and Columbus

As of May 5, 2027, Lufthansa intends to commence 3x weekly nonstop flights between Frankfurt (FRA) and Columbus (CMH). The route is expected to be operated on Wednesdays, Fridays, and Sundays, in both directions, with the following schedule:
LH406 Frankfurt to Columbus departing 11:15AM arriving 2:00PM
LH407 Columbus to Frankfurt departing 4:20PM arriving 6:15AM (+1 day)

The 4,248-mile route is blocked at 8hr45min westbound and 7hr55min eastbound. It will be operated using a 287-seat Boeing 787-9, featuring new Allegris cabins. This includes 28 business class seats, 28 premium economy seats, and 231 economy seats. Tickets will go on sale as of tomorrow, Tuesday, October 20, 2026.

Suffice it to say that this is a very cool addition to Columbus’ network. The only international service the airport otherwise gets is on Air Canada from Toronto (YYZ) and Montreal (YUL), and on American, Southwest, and Viva from Cancun (CUN), with most of that service being seasonal.
Here’s what Dirk Janzen, VP of Lufthansa Passenger Sales for the Americas, had to say:
body_zh: 看到机场第一次获得长途服务总是很有趣，所以这里有一个非常酷的例子，俄亥俄州哥伦布市将获得有史以来第一个跨大西洋航线！虽然这对社区来说是一条非常令人兴奋的航线，但考虑到机场提供的极其慷慨的激励措施，这对航空公司来说似乎没有风险（感谢杰伊标记这一点）。

title_en: Osaka Station Hotel, Marriott Autograph Collection Review: Come For The Specialty Salon & Breakfast
title_zh: 大阪车站酒店万豪傲途格精选酒店点评：特色沙龙和早餐
summary: I spent a night at the Osaka Station Hotel, a train-themed Marriott Autograph Collection property, where the Specialty Salon lounge and breakfast buffet are among the best I've seen.
summary_zh: 我在大阪车站酒店住了一晚，这是一家以火车为主题的万豪傲途格精选酒店，那里设有特色沙龙休息室和早餐爱好者
body_en: For the hotel portion my first class quest to Japan , I had the chance to spend a night at the 418-key Osaka Station Hotel, Marriott Autograph Collection , which opened in July 2024. This followed a stay at the Bulgari Tokyo , Waldorf Astoria Osaka , and Patina Osaka , so this was my final stay of the trip.

Osaka Station Hotel is utterly fascinating. The hotel is owned by the rail company West Japan Railway Company (JR West), so it has a bit of a train theme, and for that matter, it’s located on top of Osaka Station (as you might expect based on the name).

Osaka Station Hotel is huge, given its room count, and it was also the cheapest of the hotels I visited in Osaka. While I found aspects of the public facilities of the property to be a bit uninspiring, there are things I really loved — the breakfast buffet is easily one of the best I’ve seen anywhere in the world, the Specialty Salon (which I had access to on account of my Bonvoy status) is one of the best club lounges I’ve seen anywhere , and this hotel has a proper bathhouse (for better or worse), which is always quite the experience.
body_zh: 在我前往日本的头等舱之旅中，我有机会在 2024 年 7 月开业的拥有 418 间客房的大阪车站酒店万豪傲途格精选酒店住了一晚。此前我曾入住过东京宝格丽酒店、大阪华尔道夫酒店和大阪帕蒂纳酒店，所以这是我此行的最后一次入住。
大阪车站酒店非常迷人。该酒店属于铁路公司西日本旅客铁道公司（JR West）所有，因此它有一点火车主题，就这一点而言，它位于大阪站的顶部（正如您根据名称所期望的那样）。
考虑到房间数量，大阪站酒店很大，而且也是我在大阪住过的酒店中最便宜的。虽然我发现酒店的公共设施的某些方面有点平淡，但有一些东西是我真正喜欢的——自助早餐无疑是我在世界上任何地方见过的最好的自助早餐之一，特色沙龙（我因为我的旅享家身份而可以使用）是我在任何地方见过的最好的俱乐部酒廊之一，而且这家酒店有一个合适的浴室（无论好坏），这总是一种很好的体验。

title_en: Air France & Air Côte d’Ivoire Add Codeshare, Loyalty Reciprocity: Am I In Luck?!
title_zh: 法航和科特迪瓦航空添加代码共享、忠诚互惠：我运气好吗？！
summary: Air France and Air Côte d’Ivoire will codeshare between Paris and Abidjan from October 25, 2026, with Flying Blue and sMiles reciprocity to follow. Here's why I'm cautiously excited.
summary_zh: 法航和科特迪瓦航空将于 2026 年 10 月 25 日起在巴黎和阿比让之间实现代码共享，蓝天飞行和 sMiles 互惠也将随之而来。他
body_en: Air France and Air Côte d’Ivoire have just announced plans to launch a codeshare agreement and loyalty reciprocity, and regular OMAAT readers will know why I’m excited about this, at least in theory. 😉
Air France & Air Côte d’Ivoire strengthen cooperation

Air France and Air Côte d’Ivoire have signed a reciprocal codeshare agreement for the route between Paris (CDG) and Abidjan (ABJ). Starting October 25, 2026, Air France will place its code on flights operated by Air Côte d’Ivoire, and Air Côte d’Ivoire will place its code on flights operated by Air France, giving customers wide choice of departure times between France and the Ivory Coast.

Let me emphasize that a codeshare agreement is not the same as a joint venture . The airlines can’t actually coordinate fares or schedules, so expect to still see different prices for flights on the two airlines. This is simply about each airline being able to market flights of the other airline.

On top of that, Air France and Air Côte d’Ivoire are also aligning their loyalty programs, Flying Blue and sMiles. The launch is planned for the end of 2026. With this, Flying Blue members will be able to earn and redeem miles on Air Côte d’Ivoire operated flights between Paris and Abidjan. Meanwhile sMiles members will be able to earn miles on Air France operated flights between Abidjan and Paris, and redeem miles across the entire Air France network.

法航与科特迪瓦航空加强合作

summary_zh: Autoflight V5000 矩阵 william.moore@…
body_en: The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. title_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal
title_zh: 土耳其签署价值 110 亿美元的欧洲战斗机协议
summary: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017
summary_zh: 土耳其签署价值 110 亿美元的欧洲战斗机协议 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact.

body_en: The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production.

title_en: Why Hotel Credit Cards Are Worth It, Even If You’re Not Loyal To A Hotel Group
title_zh: 为什么酒店信用卡是值得的，即使你不忠于酒店集团
summary: Hotel credit cards can pay for themselves through free night certificates, even if you're not loyal to any hotel group. Here's why they're worth considering, plus other perks.
summary_zh: 即使您不忠于任何酒店集团，酒店信用卡也可以通过免费住宿券自行支付。这就是为什么他们值得保守的原因
body_en: There are all kinds of travel rewards credit cards out there — there are transferable points cards, there are airline credit cards, and there are hotel credit cards. When it comes to the value of holding onto credit cards without much spending, I’d say that hotel credit cards represent the best value, on balance.

That’s definitely the case if you’re loyal to a particular hotel loyalty program, but it’s even the case for those who are “free agents,” meaning those people who don’t have elite status with a hotel loyalty program, and aren’t otherwise usually loyal to a hotel group.

Let me explain why, though let me emphasize that I’m not suggesting you should use these cards for everyday spending. If you want to maximize your travel rewards, I recommend using cards earning transferable points currencies , like the Chase Sapphire Preferred® Card ( learn more ), Citi Strata Premier® Card ( learn more ), or American Express® Gold Card ( learn more ). Not only do these cards give you the most flexibility, but they also often have valuable bonus categories on spending.
Mid-range hotel credit cards largely pay for themselves

Great welcome bonuses aside, in general I think airline credit cards are primarily worth it if you’re at least somewhat loyal to an airline. That’s because these cards often have benefits when flying with a particular airline, but the cards don’t really “pay” for themselves.
body_zh: 旅行奖励信用卡有很多种——有可转让积分卡、航空公司信用卡和酒店信用卡。当谈到在不花太多钱的情况下持有信用卡的价值时，我认为总的来说，酒店信用卡代表了最好的价值。
如果您忠于某个特定的酒店忠诚度计划，情况肯定是这样，但对于那些“自由代理人”来说也是如此，这意味着那些没有酒店忠诚度计划的精英地位的人，并且通常不忠诚于酒店集团。

summary: Nonstop flights between London Heathrow Airport (LHR) and Phuket International Airport (HKT) in Thailand were launched by Virgin… The post Virgin Atlantic launches first nonstop Heathrow-Phuket flights using Boeing 787s appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 维珍航空开通了伦敦希思罗机场(LHR)和泰国普吉国际机场(HKT)之间的直飞航班…
body_en: Nonstop flights between London Heathrow Airport (LHR) and Phuket International Airport (HKT) in Thailand were launched by Virgin Atlantic on October 18, 2026. This marks the first direct service between Heathrow and the Thai beach destination.
The airline announced the route almost a year ago. It will operate as a seasonal winter service using Boeing 787-9 aircraft.
Three weekly flights from mid-October to late March, with a return trip of nearly 14 hours
According to schedule data from aviation analytics company Cirium, the route will run three times a week from mid-October until late March.
Flight VS214 departs Heathrow at 15:45 local time. and arrives in Phuket at 09:55 local time the next day, a scheduled flight time of 12 hours and 10 minutes.
After a 110-minute turnaround, return flight VS215 leaves Phuket at 11:45 local time and lands in London at 19:20 local time the same day, taking 13 hours and 40 minutes.
Boeing 787-9s with 66 premium seats operate the route ahead of a planned cabin refit

Virgin Atlantic’s 787-9s seat 258 passengers. The cabin includes 31 Upper Class seats that convert to flatbeds in a 1-1-1 layout, 35 Premium seats in a 2-3-2 layout, and 192 Economy seats in a 3-3-3 layout. Of the Economy seats, 36 are Economy Delight seats with extra legroom.
The airline plans to reconfigure its 787 fleet with more premium seating. The new layout will have 44 Upper Class seats, 56 Premium seats and 127 Economy seats.
Phuket is a popular winter destination for European travelers, and Virgin Atlantic will face established competition on routes from Europe.

title_en: United CEO Scott Kirby On Wealth Tax, Flying Private, And Being Betrayed By American
title_zh: 美联航首席执行官斯科特·柯比（ Scott Kirby ）谈财富税、私人飞行和被美国人背叛
summary: United CEO Scott Kirby sat down with the New York Times and covered a wealth tax, flying private, middle seat pricing, and how being fired by American felt like betrayal.
summary_zh: 美联航首席执行官斯科特·柯比（ Scott Kirby ）与《纽约时报》坐下来讨论了财富税、飞行私人、中间座位定价以及如何被美国人解雇
body_en: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby is one of the airline industry’s most outspoken people . He sometimes rubs people the wrong way, and other times he downright confuses people. However, no matter how you feel about him personally, there’s no denying that he has done an amazing job leading a change in trajectory for the airline compared to competitors. That brings us to the latest fascinating interview featuring Kirby…
The 10 most memorable things Kirby said in NYT interview

Yesterday the New York Times published an interview with Kirby , and as usual, it contains quite the claims and takes. I’d like to briefly share the 10 claims he made that I found to be most interesting (and we’ll ignore his schedule, which he claims is the most unusual of any CEO ). In no particular order:

Kirby defended charging more to avoid a middle seat by explaining that “there are some customers who want to sit in a window seat or a better seat, and that costs money to deliver,” and says the way to give everyone what they want is “to charge for the services and products that those customers want”

Kirby says that while airfare has gone up, “the truth is they’re really bouncing off an artificial low from Covid,” and four out of eight publicly traded US airlines are going to lose money this year, so they “have to charge enough that it covers the cost of flying, and it’s expensive to fly airplanes”
Kirby says that people confuse management and leadership, and his job is “really to make five decisions a year — the big decisions with no clear right or wrong answer that only the C.E.O. can make”
body_zh: 美国联合航空公司首席执行官斯科特·柯比是航空业最直言不讳的人之一。他有时会以错误的方式惹恼人们，有时他会彻底迷惑人们。然而，无论你个人对他的看法如何，不可否认的是，与竞争对手相比，他在带领航空公司改变发展轨迹方面做得非常出色。这给我们带来了柯比最新的精彩采访……
柯比在《纽约时报》采访中说过的最令人难忘的 10 句话
昨天《纽约时报》发表了对柯比的采访，和往常一样，其中包含了相当多的主张和看法。我想简要分享他提出的 10 条我认为最有趣的主张（我们将忽略他的日程安排，他声称这是所有首席执行官中最不寻常的）。排名不分先后：
柯比辩称，收取更多费用是为了避免坐在中间座位，他解释说，“有些顾客想要坐在靠窗的座位或更好的座位上，而这需要花钱才能送货”，并表示，为每个人提供他们想要的东西的方法是“对这些顾客想要的服务和产品收费”
